The capital outlay label rule calls for "Capital Outlay: <function>". The function is missing here, and the page does not name one for the Capital Projects Fund.

This is a mixed grants and contributions line with no printed breakdown, so it is kept as one line. However, the Statement of Activities (p3) shows capital grants of 402,382 under Public works, and the General Fund holds 402,382 restricted for Federal programs (p4). Most of it may therefore be federal grants. The same applies to detail[7] (501,220).

This is a cost-type line (power, gas, phone) but its category is the same word as the utilities function category, so the two can be confused. A cost-type name such as Utilities (Power, Gas, Phone) would be clearer.
